title: The Rongorongo Script Enigma
hook: What secrets hide in Easter Island's undeciphered glyphs?
headline: Easter Island's puzzling glyphs

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1864, French missionary Eugène Eyraud reported strange wooden tablets with glyphs.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: In the early 20th century, a researcher photographed dozens of tablets stored in a missionary house.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: In the early 20th century, a scholar catalogued many glyphs, noting no known language match.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent DNA analysis suggests the tablets might be relatively recent forgeries, sparking debate.

end.line: Could these glyphs be a clever 19th-century hoax?

description: Explore the mystery of Easter Island's undeciphered rongorongo tablets.
